main_diagnosis: The `forward` function in `SimulatorStep` is completely unimplemented — it contains only a placeholder (`...`) and returns `state.copy()` without any SIR dynamics. This means the simulator never evolves the state, producing constant trajectories that are entirely inconsistent with any real epidemic dataset. The resulting log-likelihood scores (NLE ~4.78e+30) confirm the model outputs are nonsensical. The `parameters` attribute is also never initialized, meaning `get_parameters()` will raise an `AttributeError` before any simulation can run.

issues.description: The `forward` function body is a stub (`...`) and simply returns `state.copy()`. No SIR transition logic is implemented, so the simulator never changes S, I, or R across any time step. This is the primary reason for the catastrophic NLE values.
issues.suggestion: Implement discrete-time stochastic SIR dynamics. Let `beta = parameters[0]` (transmission rate) and `gamma = parameters[1]` (recovery rate). Compute `N = S + I + R`. Draw new infections as `new_infections = rng.binomial(S, 1 - np.exp(-beta * I / N))` and new recoveries as `new_recoveries = rng.binomial(I, 1 - np.exp(-gamma))`. Then update: `next_S = S - new_infections`, `next_I = I + new_infections - new_recoveries`, `next_R = R + new_recoveries`. Return `{'S': int(next_S), 'I': int(next_I), 'R': int(next_R)}`. Using `binomial` draws with exponential-waiting-time probabilities gives a realistic discrete stochastic SIR that is differentiable enough for SBI and matches observed epidemic curves.

issues.description: The `parameters` attribute is never initialized in `__init__`, so calling `get_parameters()` (and therefore `step()`) before an explicit `set_parameters()` call raises `AttributeError: 'SimulatorStep' object has no attribute 'parameters'`.
issues.suggestion: Add default parameter initialization in `__init__`: `self.parameters = np.array([0.3, 0.1])` (reasonable COVID-19 priors: beta~0.3, gamma~0.1, i.e. R0~3 and ~10-day infectious period). This ensures the simulator can run out-of-the-box and that SBI optimization has a sensible starting point.
